_comment: Cameras on the plant for the camera row on the Camera screen. CAM-01 is the incident camera: recorded GasVid MOV_1242 (METEC metered release) with executed OWLv2+SAM2 model output, mapped approximately to the compressor discharge area of the synthetic plant (engine/data/facility). CAM-02..04 loop other recorded GasVid/METEC clips picked as having no visible plume; they are not in the engine's knowledge graph and are not live feeds. CAM-01 (event 1, MOV_1237) and CAM-02 (event 2, MOV_1239) are the incident cameras; their feeds are served per incident by the UI API.
